description: Tab Plus for Google+ is a tab app for all your Google+ needs. By removing all advertisements and giving you a host of new features, we've made the best even better! Be at the forefront of your social activity from the ease of your menu bar, without the need to open an internet browser window. We provide you with a familar and comprehensive desktop layout of Google+, and with the click of a button, you can toggle to a more simplified and neat little mobile window as well.
